prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop web interface concept at 1440×900 for Ardor’s interactive User manual
Primary request: Design a complete web page screenshot for an interactive learning surface. This is Option B, “Pedal atlas”.
Structure: a compact top navigation rail; then a single large instrument-inspection field. Center a nearly top-down pedal at 68% viewport width and 73% viewport height. Arrange six precise annotation stations around the actual FS1, FS2, FS3, FS4, touchscreen and encoder positions. Add a narrow left mode index, a narrow right event log, and a bottom combination tray that does not hide the controls.
Interaction state: the rear-center encoder is selected and rotated clockwise. Its expanded annotation reads ENCODER, TURN CLOCKWISE, Raise master output, MASTER 72 → 73. The screen shows the preset map and master-volume scale at 73.
Visual world: Ardor’s established playable nomenclature plate: graphite, slate, bone lettering, muted labels, hard hairline rules, live red only for active state, square geometry, calibrated ticks and bracket corners.
Subject/reference: preserve the supplied pedal’s proportions, four-switch corner layout, centered widescreen touchscreen, rear-center encoder, textured black enclosure and metal footswitches.
Constraints: a usable web interface screenshot, not a poster; no browser chrome, marketing hero, floating rounded cards, gradients, neon glow, glass, decorative grid, extra controls, fake claims, or logos besides ARDOR.
